answer.summary: A medium rustic mining town on a slope near the founding stone: a mine head with headframe at the bottom edge, a cart station at the centre, four miners' cottages, a smelter, assay office, tavern, foreman's house on high ground and a storehouse, joined by a lamp-lit street. The minecart rails down to the mine can't be built yet, so they wait while the town goes up.
